authoritativeBlueprintCategories.name: Navigation & User Flow
authoritativeBlueprintCategories.description: Seamless semantic header, bottom navigation dock, HUD lens toggle (All, Resonant, Quiet), keyboard shortcuts (Esc, 1-4), and fluid transitions.

authoritativeBlueprintCategories.name: Responsive & Accessible UI
authoritativeBlueprintCategories.description: Full WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios (4.87:1 on dark void), prefers-reduced-motion support, comprehensive ARIA landmarks (banner, nav, main, feed, form, status), and responsive layouts across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1920px).
